title: Everything Must Go
cn: 第 19 集 · 清仓大甩卖
novel:
Lily [[sold|sell]] her [[paintings|painting]] to [[pay off|pay off]] her [[debt|debt]]. Her art was [[terrible|terrible]], but Barney [[bought|buy]] them as an [[investment|investment]].

"These will be worth [[millions|millions]] someday," Barney [[declared|declare]], [[holding|hold]] up a [[crooked|crooked]] portrait.

Lily was [[grateful|grateful]] but [[suspicious|suspicious]]. "Why are you being so [[generous|generous]]?" she asked.

"Because I'm your friend," Barney said. "And because I have [[terrible|terrible]] [[taste|taste]] in art."

Marshall [[watched|watch]] the [[transaction|transaction]] with [[relief|relief]]. The debt was finally gone. They could [[breathe|breathe]] again.

At the [[gallery|gallery]], Lily's artwork drew small crowds. Some people laughed. Others nodded politely. None of it [[sold|sell]] — except to Barney.

Lily realized that true friends didn't just accept your flaws. Sometimes they [[bought|buy]] them and hung them on their wall.

investment.en: money put into something for profit

millions.en: a very large amount of money
